name: envfence
description: Type-safe environment variable parsing with a chainable schema, dotenv-style file loading, and great error messages. Zero deps. ~2KB gzipped.

scripts.size: tsup src/index.ts --format esm,cjs --minify --clean --silent && node -e "const z=require('zlib'),fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['dist/index.js','dist/index.cjs']){const b=fs.readFileSync(f);console.log(f.padEnd(18), (b.length/1024).toFixed(2)+' KB minified', '/', (z.gzipSync(b).length/1024).toFixed(2)+' KB gzipped')}" && npm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
